sample.calendar_rule: common trading days of the six ETFs = real KRX calendar; synthetic paths are placed on the same date index

pipeline.svr: T12 fit_annual / forecast_year unchanged (configs/t12_annual_expanding_v2.json folds: expanding, inner_train_fraction 0.7)
pipeline.cusum_scope: within calendar year (residuals of one annual fit); first valid index = w-1
pipeline.w1_alarm_threshold: pipeline_garch_annual_max (W1 frozen research/window_study_w1/results/03_synthetic/pipeline/pipeline_thresholds.csv) — used only for descriptive first-alarm dates; W1 0/4 eligibility verdict unchanged
pipeline.individual_signal_threshold: W3 calibrated: T >= 0.95 quantile of the annual maximum over own-valid days (position >= w-1) in H0_CALIBRATION reps, per (ticker, policy, w); W1 pipeline_garch_annual_max kept only as a reference/integrity comparison
pipeline.w1_common_integrity_check: recompute W1 alarm metrics (common sample, W1 thresholds) for the six ETFs and match the W1 aggregate

tail_score.pool: per (ticker, policy, w, position-in-year bin): all H0_CALIBRATION reps x own-valid evaluation days 2021-2025 in that bin
tail_score.table: sorted pool thinned to K equally spaced order statistics (exact count scaling); values above the pool maximum get u = 1/(N_pool+1) — no extrapolation
tail_score.nan_rule: T NaN (NOT_AVAILABLE or tau<=0) -> Q NaN; never 0
tail_score.position_bins_meaning: bin k = positions [edge_k, edge_{k+1}) within the calendar year (0-based trading day); only own-valid positions (>= w-1) enter
tail_score.same_transform_for_all_nulls: Q is a fixed statistic built from the DCC-t H0_CALIBRATION tables; H0-A and CCC-t evaluations use the same transform (the test statistic must not change with the null)

joint.lag_rule: anchor ETF at day t unlagged; every other member uses max_{l in lags} Q(t+l) on the 2021-2025 trading-day sequence (crossing a year boundary allowed; NaN ignored; all-NaN -> NaN)
joint.anchor_rule: 069500 if in S, else the first member of S in universe.tickers order
joint.J_all: min over members (anchor unlagged, others lag-maxed); any member NaN -> NaN
joint.J_k: k-th largest over members, k=2 (needs >= 2 non-NaN)
joint.available_at: close of t + max(0, largest positive lag actually used by the members that determine the statistic)

primary_test_statistics.S1: M_S1 = max over policy, w, evaluation day of J_all(S1) (= J_2 for two members)
primary_test_statistics.S2..S5: C_Sk = max over (policy, w) cells with |E| >= min_E of mean_{t in E_{k-1}(p,w)} Qlag_new(p,w,t); E_{k-1}(p,w) = {t : J_2(S_{k-1}, p, w, t) >= c_E}
primary_test_statistics.c_E_meaning: -log(0.01): two members each at marginal null tail <= 1%
primary_test_statistics.joint_k2_of_Sk: reported descriptively with its own null p, not part of the alpha budget; k=2 alone never claims new-ETF participation
primary_test_statistics.conditional_null_validity: unconditional pipeline only (E regenerated every rep; never mixed with a conditional-on-observed-E null). Check under H1_POWER scenarios where the previous stage truly changes but the new ETF does not: S2-S5 under V1, S3-S5 under V2. If the Wilson 95% lower bound of the stage rejection rate exceeds 0.02, the stage conditional test is NULL_MODEL_INVALID (조건부 귀무 불성립) and the fixed sequence stops there

joint.secondary_test_statistic: M_S = max over policy, w, evaluation day of J_all(S) for each of 57 subsets; J_2(S) descriptive only (J_2 of a superset is driven by its strongest pair)
joint.new_ticker_columns: for S2..S5 store new ETF daily Q, best lag, and its available_at separately
joint.duplicate_anchor_rule: a non-anchor ETF's single reaction may serve up to five anchor days through the lag search (in J and in the conditional mean over E); the same rule runs in every null rep, which calibrates it
joint.nasdaq_information_date_note: 133690 trades on KRX; the US underlying reacts on the previous US session — the KRX-date lag is not an economic lead-lag
joint.stage_also_report: J_all(S_k) and J_2(S_k) maxima with their own null p (descriptive, outside alpha)

null_models.H0B_primary: DCC(1,1)-t: GARCH(1,1) margins with constant mean and standardized Student-t; DCC correlation targeting Qbar = sample correlation of standardized residuals; joint multivariate t (nu_c) for second stage and simulation; fitted separately for each evaluation year y on returns strictly before y-01-01 (expanding, §10 시간 경계)
null_models.H0B_sensitivity: CCC-t: same margins, constant R = Qbar, multivariate t
null_models.fit_sample: per evaluation year y: 2019-01-03 .. last trading day before y (2021: 493 obs ... 2025: 1476 obs). No other fit window may be added later
null_models.simulation: per rep and evaluation year y: one path from model_y (burn-in 500) on the real date index 2019-01-03..y-12-31; SVR fit for y uses the simulated history < y; only year y is evaluated from that path. Lags crossing a year boundary combine Q of different year paths (documented artifact)

validity_gate.N1_numeric: optimizer success; margins alpha,beta >= 0 and alpha+beta < 0.999; 2.1 < nu < 200; DCC a,b >= 0, a+b < 0.999; no parameter within 1e-4 of a bound; all simulated R_t positive definite with unit diagonal; evaluated for every year model; a margin failing in any year makes that ETF H0-B invalid; a joint (a, b, nu) failure in any year makes every statistic invalid
validity_gate.N2_recovery: unit tests recover DCC-t parameters on synthetic data (tests/unit/test_joint_cusum_w3.py)
validity_gate.N3_per_etf: per year model y: observed statistic on returns < y vs 0.5%-99.5% envelope of the same statistic on the simulated history < y (H0_CALIBRATION reps); a statistic fails if outside in >= 2 of 5 years; zero share passes if observed <= 0.02; Ljung-Box(10) of fitted standardized z and z^2 fails if p < 0.01 in >= 2 of 5 years; ETF passes N3 if no statistic fails
validity_gate.N4_per_pair: per year as N3 (statistic fails if outside in >= 2 of 5 years); pair invalid if >= 2 of its 3 statistics fail
validity_gate.N5_marginal_cusum: median and IQR of observed T(i,p,w) over own-valid 2021-2025 days vs null envelope — DIAGNOSTIC ONLY, not a gate (sustained variance shifts are exactly the tested departure; gating on them would be circular)
validity_gate.consequence: H0-B test of a statistic is valid only if every member ETF passes N3, no member pair fails N4 and N1 holds; otherwise NULL_MODEL_INVALID. Fixed-sequence: if S3 (153130) is NULL_MODEL_INVALID the confirmatory chain stops and S4, S5 are reported but cannot be confirmatory (draft §8.2 + §10 consequence; decided before any joint statistic is computed)
validity_gate.robustness_initial_condition: ROBUSTNESS group: burn-in 2000 instead of 500 for 1000 H0_EVALUATION-like reps; report quantiles of M_S1 and C_Sk vs main (diagnostic)
validity_gate.dcc_vs_ccc: CCC-t evaluation uses the same rep seeds as DCC-t (common random numbers)

H0A.rule: per ETF and calendar year draw one transform; apply it to the own-valid segment [w-1, end] of every (policy, w) path of that ETF-year; anchor ETF 069500 is also transformed
H0A.role: auxiliary; never replaces H0-B; the two methods are not combined as independent evidence

multiple_testing.primary_procedure: fixed sequence S1 -> S2 -> S3 -> S4 -> S5, each at 0.02; the chain stops at the first stage that is not rejected or is NOT_ESTIMABLE / NULL_MODEL_INVALID / INSUFFICIENT_MONTE_CARLO; later stages are computed and reported but not confirmatory
multiple_testing.secondary_procedure: Holm over 57 subsets at 0.02; sensitivity: Westfall-Young single-step minP over the same null reps
multiple_testing.mc_p_value: (1 + #{null >= obs}) / (B + 1); zero exceedances reported as '<= 1/(B+1)', never smaller
multiple_testing.mc_ci: Clopper-Pearson 99% on #exceed / B; a decision whose CI contains its threshold -> INSUFFICIENT_MONTE_CARLO
multiple_testing.family_resolution_rule: a family is INSUFFICIENT_MONTE_CARLO if B * (its strictest threshold) < 10 (secondary strictest 0.02/57 = 0.000350877 -> B >= 28,500)
multiple_testing.day_level_critical: S1: (1-0.02) quantile of null M_S1; secondary subset S: (1-0.02/57) quantile of null M_S (Bonferroni, same resolution rule)

episodes.day_rule: significant day = J_max(S, t) = max over (policy, w) of the family statistic >= day-level critical
episodes.episode_level_statistic: cumulative excess sum(J_max - c0) over a run of J_max >= c0; null = max over runs per rep; boundary/duration claims only if this episode p <= 0.02 and the S1 day-level test rejected

direction.ratio: mean e^2 over [start, end] / mean e^2 over the 60 evaluation-available days before start (same policy)
direction.w2_cross_reference: W2 EXPANSION / CONTRACTION / HIGH_LEVEL / LOW_LEVEL candidate days (descriptive)

walk_forward_short.w2_rules: zero-variance NaN with reason, strict-past expanding mid-rank, min reference 252, upper 0.90 / lower 0.10
walk_forward_short.energy_statistic: E(h) = log(mean e^2[t-h+1..t] / mean e^2[t-h-59..t-h]), h in {1,3,7,14}; zero denominator -> NaN; exploratory candidate with marginal calibration tail only

short_window_eligibility.critical: per (ticker, policy, w) 0.95 quantile of the annual max over own-valid days (position >= w-1) in H0_CALIBRATION reps
short_window_eligibility.size_rule: H0_EVALUATION holdout reps any-alarm per ETF-year (own-valid days): Wilson upper <= 0.10
short_window_eligibility.power_rule: V1 affected ETFs, detection within 60 days: Wilson lower >= 0.15, >= 30 detected, median delay <= 30
short_window_eligibility.degeneracy: share of NaN (tau<=0 or invalid) and number of distinct values under the null

alternatives.duration: to the end of that calendar year

V6.correlation_only: innovation correlation replaced by R_alt: off-diagonal = max(Qbar_ij, 0.7) for all pairs, projected to nearest PD correlation; variances unchanged

V7.normal_common_shock: one-day standardized innovation z_i = -6 * sign(Qbar_{i,069500}) (069500: -6), no parameter change — negative control (counts as null)

price.start_rule: returns from the close of joint_confirmed_at (available_at) + 1 day
price.matching: same ETF and year, W2 U_V(q=20) decile at that day (strict past), no candidate within +-20 days; matching variables use information available at that day only
price.inference: date-block bootstrap (block 20) for CIs; no iid t-test
price.label: EXPLORATORY_REUSED_DATA

monte_carlo.seed_rule: r2h.annual_expanding.config.rng_for(study_id, seed, domain, rep); DCC and CCC evaluation share the H0_EVALUATION seeds (common random numbers); holdout uses its own domain
monte_carlo.reps_freeze: research/joint_cusum_w3/MC_REPS_FREEZE.md (lock-2 section) after the lock-2 benchmark and before any observed joint statistic
monte_carlo.over_budget_action: stop and report required compute and attainable alpha (D1); do not start a multi-day run without approval
monte_carlo.extension_rule: if any primary-stage or secondary-Holm decision is INSUFFICIENT_MONTE_CARLO at B=50,000, run exactly one pre-specified extension of +25,000 H0_EVALUATION reps (DCC) and decide again, only if the total wall time stays within max_total_wall_hours; never extend to chase significance

amends: W3-lock-1 (9cdeccb) after the full authorization text (§6 tail–§12) was received; no observed joint statistic had been computed
H0A_diagnostics: junction count, number of allowed shifts per ETF-year-window (L_w), duplicate transforms across reps, year boundary (transforms stay within a year)
